topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell rang just as the sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky in eerie strokes of orange and purple. When I opened the door, there they were—flowers, a bouquet so vibrant it seemed to glow in the dimming light. Red roses, their thorns sharp and threatening, mixed with lilies that smelled too sweet, almost suffocating. No card, no note, just a folded piece of paper that fluttered to the ground when I picked them up. I scanned the street, the shadows growing longer, but saw no one. My hands trembled slightly as I carried them inside, the silence of my home now heavy and uninviting. I placed them on the kitchen table, the petals stark against the white surface, and I couldn’t help but feel a chill, despite the warmth of the room.
